SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE = 'QNA'
AND ASK_TYPE = 'PUBLIC'
AND ASK_TYPE = #{askType}

SELECT BOARD_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, REGISTER, REGIST_DT, ASK_TYPE FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND BOARD_TYPE = 'QNA'
SELECT BOARD_ID, ANSWER_CONTENT, ANSWERER, ANSWER_DT FROM QNA_ANSWER WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD ( BOARD_ID, BOARD_TYPE, TITLE, SEARCH_CHOSUNG, CONTENT, VIEW_CNT, REGIST_DT, REGISTER, ASK_TYPE ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, 'QNA', #{title}, #{searchChosung}, #{content}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{register}, #{askType} )
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET TITLE = #{title}, SEARCH_CHOSUNG = #{searchChosung}, CONTENT = #{content}, ASK_TYPE = #{askType}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDUSR = #{updusr} WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND BOARD_TYPE = 'QNA'

MERGE INTO QNA_ANSWER target USING (VALUES (#{boardId}, #{answerContent}, #{answerer})) source(board_id, answer_content, answerer) ON target.BOARD_ID = source.board_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.ANSWER_CONTENT = source.answer_content, target.ANSWERER = source.answerer, target.ANSWER_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (BOARD_ID, ANSWER_CONTENT, ANSWERER, ANSWER_DT) VALUES (source.board_id, source.answer_content, source.answerer, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
